nothing-ever-changes.name: Progress
nothing-ever-changes.line: I keep seeing the same problems year after year, and nothing changes.
nothing-ever-changes.why: Keeps the year-after-year feeling, says the 'nothing changes' the ID names, and swaps the problem label Gridlock for an area label like the rest of the heading.

nothing-ever-changes.name: Change
nothing-ever-changes.line: Nothing ever seems to change where I live, no matter how bad things get.
nothing-ever-changes.why: Says the pain the way people put it out loud, grounded in where the person lives.

groups-go-nowhere.name: Groups
groups-go-nowhere.line: The groups I'm part of talk a lot and never get anything done.
groups-go-nowhere.why: Covers boards, clubs and committees, not only meetings, and says what goes wrong: talk without action.

shouting-into-void.name: Speaking up
shouting-into-void.line: I speak up about what I care about, and it feels like shouting into the void.
shouting-into-void.why: Says what the person did and what came back, using the everyday phrase the ID names, and makes the name an area label like the rest of the heading.

shouting-into-void.name: Being heard
shouting-into-void.line: I call, write and post about what matters to me, and nothing comes back.
shouting-into-void.why: Concrete about the effort, so it reads apart from Gridlock (the world not changing) and Helping (not knowing what to do).

alone-in-caring.name: Allies
alone-in-caring.line: I feel alone in caring about this where I live.
alone-in-caring.why: Names the loneliness the ID describes, which separates it from Coordination (finding existing efforts).
